channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: OPINION: Far-right Bardella is beatable in 2027, but no one looks capable of it
item.description: Marine Le Pen won't be the next president of France, but could her protégé Jordan Bardella win next year's race? Bardella has flaws, writes John Lichfield, but the problem is no one has yet emerged who looks capable of beating him.

item.title: New avalanche warnings issued for French Alps as ski holidays begin
item.description: Holidaymakers in the French Alps have been warned to take precautions as orange alerts were issued for four départements on Wednesday due to the risk of new avalanches.

item.title: French expression of the day: passer du coq à l'âne
item.description: This French expression may involve a rooster and a donkey but it has little to do with animals...

item.title: 'Question for 2027': The battle in France over cutting sacred summer holidays
item.description: France's teachers and the government appear to be on a collision course after France’s education minister and president have both suggested that the country’s long summer holidays could be cut by as much as half.

item.title: Replacement for cash? How the new 'digital euro' would work for Europeans
item.description: Supporters say it would let Europeans make online payments without relying on US payment system, but critics fear it would allow governments to surveil citizens' payments. How would the digital euro work?

item.title: France urges public to eat less meat for the sake of the planet and their health
item.description: The French government issued a long-awaited report Wednesday urging people to limit meat consumption for their health and also to fight climate change -- and not everyone in the country of "steak-frites" is thrilled.

item.title: French rape survivor Gisele Pelicot reveals pain and resilience in memoirs
item.description: Gisele Pelicot, a survivor of mass rapes organised by her husband at their home in southern France, reveals her shock and trauma but also her resilience in an intimate book that will hit shelves next week.

item.title: France's Pompidou museum files complaint over camera in toilets
item.description: Famed Paris modern art museum the Pompidou Centre said Wednesday it had filed a legal complaint and suspended an employee after a hidden camera was found in the women's toilets of its offices.

item.title: South western France on red alert as Storm Nils sweeps in from Atlantic
item.description: Storm Nils was set to barrel across a large swathe of western and south-western France on Wednesday, prompting national forecaster Météo-France to issue severe storm and flood warnings.

item.title: 'We need workers': How France plans to help parents make more babies
item.description: A parliamentary report has called for the creation of a ‘single family payment’ of €250 per child per month and 12 months’ ‘unified parental leave’ in an effort to slow and reverse the decline in birth rates.
